documents.title: Overview of HTTP
documents.rights_basis: Original project summary linked to CC BY-SA MDN documentation.
documents.context_prefix: MDN; API Design; HTTP request and response fundamentals; junior
documents.content: A client sends an HTTP request and a server returns a response. A junior API explanation should distinguish the method, resource URL, headers or body, response status, stateless behavior, and the possible role of intermediaries.

documents.title: API1:2023 Broken Object Level Authorization
documents.rights_basis: Original project summary linked to OWASP API Security content.
documents.context_prefix: OWASP; API Design; object-level authorization; junior
documents.content: Authentication identifies the caller but does not prove that the caller may access a requested object. Every endpoint that accepts a user-controlled object identifier needs a server-side authorization check against that exact object and action.

documents.title: Using EXPLAIN
documents.rights_basis: Original project summary linked to documentation under the PostgreSQL Licence.
documents.context_prefix: PostgreSQL; Database Reasoning; query-plan inspection; intermediate
documents.content: Read a PostgreSQL plan as a tree of scan, join, sort, and aggregate nodes. Compare estimated rows and costs with actual execution measurements when appropriate, investigate large estimate errors, and avoid assuming that an index scan is always cheaper than a sequential scan.

documents.title: Python Errors and Exceptions
documents.rights_basis: Original project summary linked to documentation under PSF Licence 2.
documents.context_prefix: Python; Programming and Debugging; exception handling; junior
documents.content: Handle expected failure modes with specific exception types, keep the protected try block narrow, use else for work that should run only after success, and use finally for cleanup. Preserve useful failure context instead of silently swallowing unexpected errors.

documents.title: Accessibility on the web
documents.rights_basis: Original project summary linked to CC BY-SA MDN documentation.
documents.context_prefix: MDN; Web Accessibility; semantic HTML and verification; junior
documents.content: Start with semantic HTML controls, preserve keyboard operation and visible focus, connect labels and errors to their inputs, provide text alternatives, and verify with both automated checks and manual keyboard or assistive-technology testing.

documents.title: Docker Get Started
documents.rights_basis: Original project summary only; Docker documentation text is not copied.
documents.context_prefix: Docker; Cloud and CI/CD; container foundations; junior
documents.content: A container runs a process from a versioned image. A reproducible Dockerfile describes image construction, runtime configuration is supplied separately, persistent data uses an explicit volume, and network exposure should be limited to required ports.

documents.title: CS2023 data, statistics, and machine-learning foundations
documents.rights_basis: Original reviewer-authored project summary; curriculum source text is not copied.
documents.context_prefix: CS2023; statistics; machine learning; evaluation; visualization; junior
documents.content: A junior data workflow starts with a clearly defined question, identifies the population and sample, checks data quality, chooses descriptive summaries and visual encodings that match the variable types, and separates training from evaluation data. A baseline and suitable metrics should be selected before comparing models. Classification metrics such as precision, recall, and F1 answer different error questions; regression metrics such as MAE and RMSE express different penalty behavior. Results should include uncertainty, limitations, leakage checks, and evidence that the chosen model generalizes beyond the training data.

documents.title: CS2023 technical communication foundations
documents.rights_basis: Original reviewer-authored project summary; curriculum source text is not copied.
documents.context_prefix: CS2023; technical communication; evidence; trade-offs; junior
documents.content: A strong junior technical explanation states the problem and constraints, presents an ordered approach, connects each decision to evidence, identifies relevant trade-offs, and closes with a verification plan. It distinguishes observed facts from assumptions, defines unfamiliar terms, uses concrete examples where helpful, and communicates limitations without hiding uncertainty.

documents.title: CS2023 reliability and observability foundations
documents.rights_basis: Original reviewer-authored project summary; curriculum source text is not copied.
documents.context_prefix: CS2023; observability; reliability; incident reasoning; junior
documents.content: A junior reliability plan defines what healthy behavior means, records structured logs for significant events, exposes metrics for traffic, errors, latency, and saturation, and uses traces when a request crosses components. Alerts should represent actionable user impact rather than every anomaly. Safe operation also needs timeouts, bounded retries, idempotency where repeated actions are possible, health checks, rollback procedures, and a post-incident review that improves the system rather than blaming an individual.

documents.title: CS2023 programming and algorithmic reasoning foundations
documents.rights_basis: Original reviewer-authored project summary; curriculum source text is not copied.
documents.context_prefix: CS2023; programming fundamentals; algorithms; complexity; testing; junior
documents.content: When a working program becomes slow at larger input sizes, first reproduce and measure the bottleneck, inspect repeated work and collection operations, and reason about how time and memory grow with input size. Choose a data structure because its operations match the access pattern, not because it is fashionable. Make one controlled change, preserve behavior with focused tests, and measure again before claiming an improvement.

documents.title: CS2023 systematic debugging foundations
documents.rights_basis: Original reviewer-authored project summary; curriculum source text is not copied.
documents.context_prefix: CS2023; debugging; production failure; logs; rollback; junior
documents.content: A safe investigation starts by confirming impact and recent changes, preserving useful logs and correlation identifiers, and reproducing the failure with the smallest controlled case. Form one hypothesis at a time, collect evidence that can disprove it, compare healthy and failing behavior, and avoid unrelated edits. If users are harmed, prefer a known rollback or containment path. Finish with a regression test and a short explanation of the cause and verification.

documents.title: CS2023 entry-level system-design reasoning
documents.rights_basis: Original reviewer-authored project summary; curriculum source text is not copied.
documents.context_prefix: CS2023; system design; requirements; API; storage; identifiers; scaling; junior
documents.content: An entry-level system design begins by clarifying functional requirements, expected traffic, data lifetime, and important failure cases. Describe a small API, the stored records and indexes, identifier generation and collision handling, and the read and write paths. Start with the simplest deployable architecture, identify the first likely bottleneck, and scale incrementally with measurement, caching, replication, or partitioning only when justified.

documents.title: CS2023 frontend component and state reasoning
documents.rights_basis: Original reviewer-authored project summary; curriculum source text is not copied.
documents.context_prefix: CS2023; frontend engineering; components; state; testing; junior
documents.content: A maintainable frontend splits components around coherent responsibilities and stable interfaces. Keep state close to the components that own it, lift it only when multiple parts need a shared source of truth, and derive values instead of duplicating them. Handle loading, empty, success, and error states explicitly. Test user-visible behavior and important data-flow boundaries rather than coupling tests to internal implementation details.

documents.title: CS2023 data-analysis and SQL reasoning
documents.rights_basis: Original reviewer-authored project summary; curriculum source text is not copied.
documents.context_prefix: CS2023; data analysis; SQL; metric definition; grain; quality; junior
documents.content: Before writing SQL, define the business metric, observation window, entity grain, and inclusion rules. Identify source tables and join keys, protect against duplicate rows, nulls, late data, and time-zone mistakes, and validate the result against simple counts or known examples. Segment only when it answers the question, and state limitations so a chart or aggregate is not presented as stronger evidence than the data supports.
